default_arch.description: The default architecture to use for package fetching. Can be overridden at the resource level.

extra_keyrings.description: A list of paths to package repository public keys for signature verification.

extra_repositories.description: A list of URLs for package repositories to use for fetching APK packages.

block.description: The Helm provider offers resources to work with OCI Helm charts and APK repositories.

chart_version.description: The chart version of the Helm chart extracted from the chart metadata.

digest.description: The SHA256 digest of the Helm chart after it is pushed to the registry.

images.description: Map of image IDs to full OCI references for resolving cg.json. When provided, the chart's values.yaml will be updated with the resolved image references.

json_patches.description: JSON RFC6902 patches to apply to the Helm chart, organized by the file to which the patch should be applied. Each file must contain the json representation of the JSON patch array to apply. It's easiest to use the jsonencode function to generate the JSON string.

name.description: The name of the Helm chart extracted from the chart metadata.

package_arch.description: The architecture of the package to fetch. If not specified, uses the provider default_arch or falls back to system defaults.

package_name.description: The name of the package to fetch from the package repository.

package_version.description: The version of the package to fetch from the package repository, pinned via APK's `name=version` constraint syntax. If not specified, the latest available version will be used.

repo.description: The repo in the OCI registry where the Helm chart will be pushed.

block.description: Manages a Helm chart in an OCI registry from an APK package.
